Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Atlas)

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today — good discussion on Atlas's ingestion needs and the latency/cost constraints for your support assistant use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key notes from discovery:
  - Expected peak throughput: ~50 concurrent sessions, avg 600 tokens/session
  - Latency target: 300–500ms tail for short responses
  - Data residency: US-only, HIPAA-adjacent controls needed for logs

- Proposed next steps:
  1) Schedule a short walkthrough of Redwood's Atlas demo (20–30 min) focused on routing, caching, and cost profiles
  2) Share a short mutual action plan and a draft SSO/SCIM checklist for security
  3) If it looks good, we can scope a short POC for a single queue

I attached the discovery notes for your reference (discovery-notes.pdf). Are you available for a demo Wed or Thu this week (2/11 or 2/12)? If not, send a few times that work and I’ll get it on the calendar.

Best,
Marissa
